item.title: Binance says $6.3bn stolen in biggest crypto heist in history: What we know - Al Jazeera
item.description: Binance says about $6.3bn was taken in the October 29 Binance hack, with investigators pointing to North Korea’s Lazarus Group.

item.title: Is North Korea's Lazarus Group behind massive $6.3 Billion Binance Hack? - Daily Pakistan
item.description: Investigators tracing the $6.3 billion Binance theft are looking at North Korea’s Lazarus hacking network.

item.title: Three New iPads Rumored to Launch in First Half of 2027 - MacRumors
item.description: Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman says Apple will release an iPad Air with an OLED display, a new iPad Pro and an entry-level iPad in the first half of 2027.
